issue: Android connects but remains on waiting for game frames with Windows Device Simulator disabled
root_cause: Ordinary Windows embedding created only an HWND wrapper; Session.data/path were null. RemoteFrame therefore always returned null while remoteRunning reported the live process as running.
live_evidence: The phone established H.264; the host thread was in RemoteGameServer.video waiting for the first raw frame. The actual game launch had no simulator arguments or shared frame file.

before.failure: AssertionError: Embedded Remote lacks capture mapping

after_source_tests.clj_kondo: 0 errors, 7 pre-existing warnings outside changed lines

implementation.ordinary_input: Forward Remote mouse events through the owned native window; use actual desktop cursor outside the Remote input lease

user_confirmation: User confirmed that enabling Device Simulator restores the phone picture; ordinary embedded capture was the missing path.
limitations: FPS measured on local loopback with an isolated real Windows engine, not phone Wi-Fi display FPS
No physical Android device available for logcat/MediaCodec validation
